guidance.claim: Management aims to inch closer to the 26% to 28% margin band.
guidance.quote: while we will not shy away from making investments, we want to inch closer to our 26% to 28% band and we'll make all efforts to climb towards 26%.
guidance.speaker: Samir Seksaria

guidance.claim: Ongoing impact from the new labor code is expected to be minimal.
guidance.quote: We expect the ongoing impact to be minimal, around 10 to 15 basis points.
guidance.speaker: Samir Seksaria

guidance.claim: Total order book is projected to reach around US$38-39 billion for the year.
guidance.quote: If this trend continues, we will be somewhere closer to about US$38- 39 billion for the year, which will be one of the highest.
guidance.speaker: Kumar Rakesh

guidance.claim: Management remains optimistic about reaching the aspiration of having revenue better than FY25 in Q4.
guidance.quote: I think as far as international revenue in Q4 is concerned, we are optimistic, and we'll take every step that's required to see we reach the aspiration of having a revenue better than FY '25.
guidance.speaker: Kumar Rakesh

guidance.claim: AI revenues are expected to continue to grow with a strong growth rate.
guidance.quote: We are seeing increased traction, good momentum across our client base and we expect AI revenues to continue to grow with a strong growth rate.
guidance.speaker: Aarthi Subramanian

guidance.claim: No revenue pickup is expected for the 2nd phase until a formal final PO is received.
guidance.quote: unless formal final PO is received, we don't expect the revenue pickup in BSNL (for the 2nd phase), but we will keep you posted whenever it happens.
guidance.speaker: Nitin Padmanabhan

reported.claim: In Q3, the company delivered ₹67,087 crore in revenue.
reported.quote: In Q3, we delivered ₹67,087 crore in revenue.
reported.speaker: Nehal Shah

reported.claim: Reported currency revenue grew 2.0% sequentially and 4.9% YoY.
reported.quote: In reported currency, our revenue grew by 2.0% sequentially and 4.9% YoY .
reported.speaker: Nehal Shah

reported.claim: Q3 operating margins stood at 25.2%, remaining stable sequentially.
reported.quote: Our Q3 operating margins stood at 25.2%, remaining stable sequentially.
reported.speaker: Nehal Shah

reported.claim: AI services generate US$1.8 billion in annualized revenue, growing at 17.3% QoQ.
reported.quote: Our AI services now generate US$1.8 billion in annualized revenue and is growing at 17.3% QoQ in constant currency.
reported.speaker: Nehal Shah

reported.claim: The company achieved an overall TCV of US$9.3 billion in Q3.
reported.quote: We achieved an overall TCV of US$9.3 billion.
reported.speaker: Nehal Shah

reported.claim: LTM voluntary attrition in IT Services stands at 13.5%.
reported.quote: Last twelve months (LTM) voluntary attrition in IT Services stands at 13.5%, up by 20 basis points sequentially.
reported.speaker: Sudeep Kunnumal
